subject.title: fix: prevent hidden pre-tool text from confusing channel users

question: Should OpenClaw accept this PR's product direction of keeping pre-tool commentary private while injecting an undelivered marker into provider replay, after the known tool-call predicate gap is fixed?
rationale: The implementation direction resolves the linked message-loss/session-state drift without changing channel delivery policy, but it changes model-visible replay semantics and the linked issue was already marked as needing maintainer delivery-policy review.

options.title: Accept marker approach after fixes
options.body: Land the undelivered-marker design once it covers tool-call-containing turns regardless of stopReason and has real behavior proof.

options.title: Deliver pre-tool text instead
options.body: Require a different PR that flushes only intentionally user-visible pre-tool text while preserving commentary leak suppression.

options.title: Require explicit send semantics
options.body: Keep bare pre-tool text private and document that channel-visible confirmations must use the message tool or another explicit send path.

recommendation.title: Accept marker approach after fixes
recommendation.body: Land the undelivered-marker design once it covers tool-call-containing turns regardless of stopReason and has real behavior proof.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent current-main history owns the sampled commentary tagging and replay files most directly.
